package validationclient

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

type Client struct {
	BaseURL       string
	InternalToken string
	HTTPClient    *http.Client
}

const maxValidationResponseBytes int64 = 4 << 20

func (client Client) Validate(ctx context.Context, request domain.ValidationRunRequest) (*domain.ValidationRunResult, error) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(client.BaseURL) == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("validation orchestrator url is empty")
	}
	workspaceFiles := make([]map[string]string, 0, len(request.WorkspaceFiles))
	for _, file := range request.WorkspaceFiles {
		workspaceFiles = append(workspaceFiles, map[string]string{
			"path":    file.Path,
			"content": file.Content,
		})
	}
	body, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{
		"task_id":                  request.TaskID,
		"code_structure_type_code": request.CodeStructureTypeCode,
		"mode":                     request.Mode,
		"code_structure":           json.RawMessage(request.CodeStructure),
		"workspace": map[string]any{
			"files": workspaceFiles,
		},
		"task_metadata": request.TaskMetadata,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	httpRequest, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, strings.TrimRight(client.BaseURL, "/")+"/api/v1/validate", bytes.NewReader(body))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	httpRequest.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	if token := strings.TrimSpace(client.InternalToken); token != "" {
		httpRequest.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", token)
	}

	response, err := client.httpClient().Do(httpRequest)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = response.Body.Close() }()
	if response.StatusCode >= http.StatusBadRequest {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("validation request failed: %s", response.Status)
	}

	limited := &io.LimitedReader{R: response.Body, N: maxValidationResponseBytes + 1}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(limited)
	var payload domain.ValidationRunResult
	if err := decoder.Decode(&payload); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) || limited.N == 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid or oversized validation response")
	}
	return &payload, nil
}

func (client Client) httpClient() *http.Client {
	if client.HTTPClient != nil {
		return client.HTTPClient
	}
	return &http.Client{Timeout: 30 * time.Second}
}
